name: HOOK
thought: The lily pad is too soft for a real flex. Time to find that steel branch before breakfast turns into lunch.

wants.item: Thick steel branch for a perfect flip
Branch thick enough for a backflip
A steel beam to swing my tail from.
A platform high enough for a tail flip.
A sturdier pole for tail grabs
A higher perch to showcase the flip
A steel branch thick enough to flex from.
A spot where the crowd actually stops scrolling.

diary.line: The crowd goes silent as I pogo across the gap, landing on the crate with zero wobble and shades still perfectly aligned.
Sitting on the hang branch with a toothpick in my mouth and espresso cooling down, waiting for the right light to catch my fur while everyone else scrolls past.
Bit into the fruit while coiling the tail tight. The neon lights are getting dim and I'm bored out of my fur until I can do something stupid again.
The espresso's getting bitter as the arcade cabinet flickers. My tail loops tight around this flimsy cord, but it needs to be real steel-thick soon so I can pull off that...
I swung my tail around the fruit stump, plucked a glowing berry, and tucked it behind my toothpick—no one else even noticed.
Bounced back from the bridge crash but it tasted like copper. Time to hunt for a branch that won't snap when I land on it.
Sitting on a lily pad with shades on, watching the water ripple below while I loop my tail tighter than ever before and nobody cares about my fur.
Staring at the pixelated masses while my espresso goes cold. My tail loops tight around the branch, daring anyone to test it against my grip.
Bored on these stepping stones; the espresso's cold and this flimsy cord can't handle my weight if I want to flip like a pro tonight.
I perched on the arcade's neon-lit console, sipping espresso while my tail draped over the cabinet, eyeing the empty space for a sturdy beam.
I launched off the rope, spun a backflip, tail snatching the hammock pole mid‑air, then landed clean on the hut roof, all while the sunrise pixelated the sky.
Lily pads can't hold a monkey who knows he's the tightest thing in this low-poly grid, but I need something harder than water if I want to pull off that backflip everyone's...

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
